name: Mistral
tagline: Mistral is a French AI lab that builds both open-weight models (the Mistral and Mixtral series) and closed frontier models served through its Le Chat app and API. It's earned a reputation for squeezing strong performance out of smaller, cheaper-to-run models, which matters a lot for companies watching inference costs. It's also become the model of choice for European organisations that want strong AI capability from a company operating under EU data protection rules rather than a US or Chinese vendor.
